data.name: ÖkoMAXX Energiewerke
data.description: ÖkoMAXX Energiewerke GmbH is a small Austrian energy utility headquartered in Gänserndorf, wholly owned by PurEnergy Holding GmbH. Its core business is producing green electricity and district heating from biomass via a Syncraft gasification power plant, with biochar generated as a byproduct and registered under the Global Biochar C-Sink Standard (GCSP1127). Its primary business is electricity/heat supply, not CDR.
